description: Inspect a live TLS certificate: subject, issuer, SAN domains, validity window, days to expiry, protocol version, cipher and the full chain length. Read directly from a TLS handshake — the definitive check an agent should run before trusting an API endpoint. Use this when an agent needs to cert details, chain, expiry — straight from the socket. x402 price $0.005/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_ssl_inspector
title: SSL Certificate Inspector
